metadata.summary: Saurabh ordered three bagels from Manhattan Bagel, one for himself, one for his wife, and one for his kid, with various customizations.

messages.text: Hello Saurabh, welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It's great to see you again. What would you like to order?

I wanted to order, couple of bagels for one for my wife, one for my kids, and one for myself. For my wife, I wanted to order everything bagel, toasted with cream cheese for the kids, cinnamon bagel with, peanut butter and toasted for myself.
[2025-06-24T02:27:48.280Z] assistant: Let me get the options for your bagel choices. I will call the get_modifier_groups tool to get all the options for the bagels.
